title: NVIDIA AIStore Object Rename Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NVIDIA AIStore. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the rename object handler. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
addtionnal_details:
NVIDIA has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/NVIDIA/product-security/blob/main/2026/5889/5889.md
timeline:
